title: Interactive Clarification for Cloud Infrastructure-as-Code Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2604.02382v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: The scale and complexity of modern cloud infrastructure have made "Infrastructure-as-Code" (IaC) essential for managing deployments through declarative configurations. While large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate IaC configurations from natural language, user requests are often ambiguous and underspecified. Unlike traditional code generation, it is costly and time-consuming to test IaC configurations during the synthesis, forcing the LLMs into an almost one-shot regime. translated_title: 面向云基础设施即代码合成的交互式澄清方法
translated_abstract: 现代云基础设施的规模与复杂性使得“基础设施即代码”（IaC）成为通过声明式配置管理部署的必备手段。虽然大语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于从自然语言生成IaC配置，但用户的请求往往模糊且欠规范。与传统的代码生成不同，在合成过程中测试IaC配置的成本高且耗时，这迫使LLM处于近乎一次性生成的模式。我们观察到，IaC合成中的歧义呈现出组合结构：配置可分解为三个维度（资源、拓扑、属性），其中较高层次的决策会约束较低层次的决策。我们提出了一个无需训练的多层级消歧框架，该框架生成多样化的候选规范，识别这些维度之间的结构性分歧，按信息量对分歧进行排序，并生成有针对性的澄清问题。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种无需训练的多层级消歧框架，通过分析IaC配置在资源、拓扑、属性三个维度上的结构性分歧并生成有针对性的澄清问题，帮助大语言模型在近乎一次性的IaC合成场景中解决用户请求的模糊性问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a training-free, multi-level disambiguation framework that identifies structural disagreements across the resources, topology, and attributes axes of IaC configurations and generates targeted clarifying questions, enabling LLMs to resolve user request ambiguity in the near one-shot regime of IaC synthesis.
